exactness_boundary: Both canonical face-stabilizer frames are retained. No universal coverage of the physical contact sources has been proved.
conditional_exactness: Exact if, for each canonical family, the physical source cone is contained in the sum of its two face-stabilizer images of the certificate cone.
coefficient_convention: [k,i,j,value], upper triangle mirrored; k=0 constant, k=1..8 original visible coordinates, k=9+j auxiliary j.
source_geometry: Both Bell frames for every C1 and C2 orientation/omission pair; one frame suffices for each independently exact closed face.
public_scope: This is NOT an exact lift of the full eight-coordinate quantum set.
